name: Floor Watch head sensor board (prototype, Rev A)
purpose: Bench board for T6 (ToF cliff detection) and T4 (oblique LED retest). Not a production board.
parent: serpens (separate git; head-sensor-board is excluded via .git/info/exclude)
goal: Get the board from 'data ready' to 'ordered, assembled, bring-up measured' without wasting a fab run; hand every physical step to the human as a Human Gate.

pcb_layout_geometry.note: DRC with schematic parity 0/0/0; J1/J2 net/pad/silk match; silk clearances

layout_image_review.note: user viewed the 2026-10-02 PNG; later silk edits (0.15 mm, label re-fit) were not re-viewed by the user

gerbers.note: re-read with an independent library; not user-checked, not previewed in a fab viewer

fab_compatibility.note: not verified by an order; JLCPCB standard text height fails (high-precision option passes)

3d_models.note: illustrative boxes for XIAO stack and LED; heights assumed

artifacts.boardrepo_zip: C:/2026/Serpens_Home AI/head-sensor-board_upload.zip (user uploads manually; display not confirmed)
artifacts.regenerate: python tools/make_board.py [--reuse-routes] -> tools/check_board.py -> tools/make_outputs.py [--bom] -> tools/make_fabrication.py -> tools/verify_gerbers.py

constraints: Never fabricate measurements; expected values in docs/bringup_plan.md are calculations.
Shared tree ai-shared/ and ai-outbox/ are append-only; do not touch other agents' worktrees.
After any silk/placement change run tools/check_board.py; after any board change re-run make_fabrication and compare_gerbers --current.
